title: Claim Reason Surcharges on Pocketwire Business Profile Chargebacks
content:
Surcharge list of the claims desk for the Pocketwire Business Profile. The claim reason surcharge on a chargeback follows the reason recorded on the buyer claim opened on the chargeback's sale.

| Claim reason | Claim reason surcharge |
|---|---|
| unauthorized buyer | USD 10.00 |
| item not received | USD 5.00 |
| not as described | none |

**Formal statement.** The claim reason surcharge is 10.00 dollars when the claim's reason is unauthorized buyer, 5.00 dollars when it is item not received, and nothing otherwise.

The reason is read from the claim record as opened; a claim reason stated later by the seller or the buyer does not change it.
